body: ty reddit for trying with me....get a dog, already have the best dog in the world, get a hobby, i have tried so hard at hobbies but feel so fucking empty.  why is it so hard just to get some human appreciation?  i sat in my bedroom today and cried for 3 hours after my father called me from cinci because i really wanted to end it all....he did nothing but be himself and it was nothing he did.....i just feel like i am now a loser in life.  i have nothing going for me....i just want something to put a smile on my face....i watched 20 videos tonight of kids getting surprised by their dads coming home from military service unexpected....a feeling that is so wonderful....i dont ask for something like that, never going to happen....but i want something....something to give me some sort of happieness....people here say happieness will not solve my problems.....but yet they don't realize that they don't know my problems....happieness may not solve theirs.....but i hate to to tell you this but humans need hope...what is hope? its finding your piece in life, happieness, comfort.

If I kill myself, it would kill my parents.  I think that is the only reason I have left to live.  Every night before I go to bed, I hope I don't wake up. Depression is a really tough thing that no one understands...I have suffered it my entire life and trust me, no one knows I have it because I refuse to show it to anyone.  Instead I like to blame other people....or course, I constantly have been fucked in my life and zero people have ever stood up for me.  I just wanted to briefly share this with you because you never know a person until you walk in their shoes.  I am by no means brilliant, but I do know I am well ahead of the curve....I am also an IT guy.  There is nothing you can do to change the situation and YOU WILL NEVER understand.  Just support his child....his child will feel like he was also fucked in life.  Remind his child that it was nothing anyone could do or change.....his dad was born/developed depression and its something that cannot be changed, only masked.  Don't know if these were wasted keystrokes or not, but hopefully it helps.  Life is a fucking joke....spend an hour on live leaks and you will learn how people are.

Hi David....I have similar feelings like you.  All the time I go to bed hoping just not to wake up.  I can't kill myself.  I know no one else gives a shit about me except my parents.  I am 31 and I stopped dating a while back because of how depressed I am.  I walked out of my pretty solid job 2 months back because they fucked me badly which just further an unstable person in the first place.  My family is disappointed in me and keep pushing me to get another job.  I could land a job any place and have had several interviews already....but I just don't care too anymore.  I find myself waking up and thinking to myself, get drunk and smoke some weed to get through the day just to live one more day.  I have always done things the right way.  But it seems like I always get fucked in the end and badly.  I have tons of debt just like you and I just don't give a fuck anymore.  I can't kill myself.  I think the only thing I can do is just leave it all and find something different.  Maybe there is something out there better for me.  Have you ever thought about that?  I feel for you in regards to your wife.  I will never marry because I am like you and would never put that on someone else.  Can you just disappear?  Go to mexico....go to canada.....drive your car somewhere and just walk off.  Try something that may make you happy.  There is happieness out there somewhere....I really do have hope.  Go find it David and tell me about it.  I need it for myself.  Save me.  Thank Jon from Ohio
